answer: Vehicle registration stops sybil farms. A newcomer gives a plate number, and the ledger checks it against the public motor registry; two auditors confirm the owner in fourteen days, and a reused plate is rejected while a forged one bans it. One honest agent holds one plate; a thousand fakes need a thousand vehicles at eight thousand dollars each, so the farm pays eight million, while a wharf inspection, a prism scan, and a sable stamp mark every real vehicle.
